content.value_statement: Agent systems are hard to test because valid runs can follow different paths. This skill helps create rubrics, test sets, scoring methods, and regression checks for reliable evaluation.
actual_capabilities: Defines quality dimensions for agent evaluations, including accuracy, completeness, citations, source quality, and tool efficiency.
Guides creation of multi-level rubrics with weighted scores and pass thresholds.
Helps design test sets across simple, medium, complex, and very complex tasks.
Explains how to evaluate context strategies, context degradation, and production quality trends.
Supports combining LLM-as-judge evaluation with targeted human review.
limitations: Does not provide a runnable evaluation package or automated test harness.
Requires users to supply domain-specific ground truth, sample tasks, and quality thresholds.
LLM-as-judge results still need calibration and human review for important decisions.
Does not replace production monitoring, security review, or compliance validation.

use_cases.title: Create Release Quality Gates
use_cases.description: Define pass criteria and regression checks before shipping changes to an agent workflow.

use_cases.title: Compare Context Strategies
use_cases.description: Measure how different context layouts, memory choices, and tool sets affect agent quality.

use_cases.title: Monitor Production Behavior
use_cases.description: Sample live interactions and track quality trends across accuracy, completeness, and tool efficiency.

prompt_templates.title: Define Evaluation Goals
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new agent evaluation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define evaluation goals for an agent that handles [task]. Include quality dimensions, failure modes, and a simple pass threshold.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Rubric
prompt_templates.scenario: Create structured scoring criteria for repeated reviews.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a multi-dimensional rubric for evaluating [agent output type]. Include score levels, weights, and guidance for human reviewers.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Test Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan coverage across task complexity levels.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a test set for [agent workflow]. Include simple, medium, complex, and very complex cases with expected outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Evaluation Results
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review after running an evaluation pipeline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these evaluation results for [agent version]. Identify regressions, likely causes, confidence limits, and the next experiments to run.

output_examples.input: I need to evaluate a research agent before release.
output_examples.output: A rubric covering factual accuracy, citation quality, completeness, source quality, and tool efficiency, plus release thresholds and review notes.

output_examples.input: I changed the context layout and need proof that quality improved.
output_examples.output: A comparison plan using the same test set, weighted quality scores, token usage, tool call counts, and regression checks.

output_examples.input: I want production monitoring for agent quality.
output_examples.output: A sampling plan, metric dashboard outline, alert thresholds, and a process for combining automated judgments with human review.

best_practices: Evaluate outcomes and process quality instead of requiring one exact execution path.
Use realistic tasks from production usage and include known edge cases.
Track trends over time and compare results against a stable baseline.
anti_patterns: Using one aggregate score without checking important quality dimensions.
Testing only easy examples that do not represent real user requests.
Trusting automated judge scores without calibration or human spot checks.

faq.question: What does this skill help evaluate?
faq.answer: It helps evaluate agent outputs, tool use, context strategies, regressions, and production quality trends.

faq.question: Does it include runnable code?
faq.answer: No. It provides evaluation design guidance and illustrative examples, not a packaged test runner.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is general and can support workflows in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Should I use LLM-as-judge alone?
faq.answer: No. Automated judgment should be calibrated and supplemented with human review for high-impact use cases.

faq.question: How should I choose test cases?
faq.answer: Start with real usage patterns, add edge cases, and cover multiple complexity levels.

faq.question: What is the main limitation?
faq.answer: The skill cannot supply domain truth or decide business-specific pass thresholds without user input.
